plugins.name: limit-resume
plugins.description: Resumes the session and its idle workers when a usage limit resets, and gives Claude the current 5h and weekly usage

plugins.name: workers
plugins.description: A pane of the sessions this one orchestrates: state, branch, commits ahead, changed files, last message, who needs you

plugins.name: identity-keeper
plugins.description: Keeps a session's name and role across restarts and compactions

plugins.name: proof-gate
plugins.description: Asks a worker that reports done for screenshots or video, sends the proof to you, and shows an approval band

plugins.name: effort-gate
plugins.description: Denies Opus at xhigh/max for subagents and background sessions unless the user said so, and background sessions without an explicit model

plugins.name: route-ledger
plugins.description: Records the model and effort of every subagent and background launch and how it went; /routing-review shows what to tune

plugins.name: config-sync
plugins.description: Pulls the shared claude-config repo at session start, tells you when settings.shared.json changed, and applies it with /config-sync apply

plugins.name: savvy-progress
plugins.description: Progress bar above the prompt and a live agents panel (/agents-info), with crabs for scout, builder and reviewer. Copy of johnnyvizz/claude-kit savvy-progress

plugins.name: cache-tax
plugins.description: Keeps the one-hour prompt cache warm for 8h every session and shows a cold send's rewrite cost; warns, never drops. Copy of karanb192/cache-tax
